name: 'sabah 7.30 dedim ya' re-reads the time, apologises in one clause and moves on
incident: Live failure of 2026-11-19 05:23 (ADR 0014): the owner answered the day question with 'sabah 7.30 dedim ya' (I said morning 7:30!) and the bot asked 'Hangi tarih?' and then the 'Takıldık galiba' menu. A time given in an answer is taken from the text; the next missing field is asked (here none: the date is the next 07:30), with 'Haklısınız, saati aldım.'
